queries.result: First-party discovery identified the official IGAC Colombia en Mapas cadastral consultation guidance, the official IGAC Yopal gestor-catastral notice, and the official municipal geovisor landing site. No anonymous parcel response was established.

queries.query: Yopal Colombia catastro visor geográfico predios oficial Alcaldía Yopal
queries.result: First-party discovery identified Yopal’s official geovisor, the IGAC notice naming Sabanalarga as the contracted cadastral gestor for Yopal, and the IGAC open geospatial/cadastral-data page. No safe anonymous parcel geometry response was established.

registryCustodian: Sabanalarga, represented by Catasig S.A.S., is evidenced by the first-party IGAC notice as the contracted/authorized cadastral gestor serving Yopal at the time of the notice. IGAC remains the national cadastral authority and publishes Colombia en Mapas/open-data guidance; this does not by itself prove current Yopal parcel-layer availability.
serviceReview: Yopal’s official geovisor landing page returned HTTP 200 over TLS and was inspected; it is a WordPress corporate/portal shell with links for the municipal multipurpose gestor but no exposed map iframe, service URL, schema, CRS, or anonymous parcel query in the fetched HTML. The official IGAC ArcGIS REST route https://mapas2.igac.gov.co/server/rest/services/catastropublico30092024/MapServer?f=pjson was attempted with a bounded 20-second GET and timed out; no response was observed. No login, credentials, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, private token, TLS exception, or unsafe-field request was used.
safeFieldAllowlist: stable native parcel identity only if source-proven
scopeLimits: The exact WUP point [5.33292490392046, -72.3953803617033] was preserved in latitude/longitude order and was not shifted.
No exact-point hit, viewer-shell result, timeout, or unavailable API response was treated as evidence of citywide cadastral absence.
A local/municipal cadastral service custodian is evidenced, but no safe native parcel ID, field schema, CRS, or full polygon was verified.
No GeoJSON sample is retained because no full parcel polygon with a source-proven stable native identity was observed.
No owner, address, contact, titleholder, personal, tax/account, certificate, or title fields were requested or retained.
This packet is research evidence only and is not source integration or admission.
uncertainty: The current Catasig/Yopal parcel-service endpoint, access policy, native field mapping, CRS, and citywide coverage remain unknown.
The IGAC open-data documentation describes national cadastral datasets and the Colombia en Mapas query workflow, but the bounded service probe did not return a usable parcel response for this packet.
Independent serial review is required before any runtime adapter qualification.
